Name: Food Packaging
Author: dollynhoevida
Description:
This mod adds a new machine that uses paper for food packaging.

How to get machine:
[spoiler]
The recipe can be bought from Gus when you have 3 hearts with him. 
[/spoiler]
How to use machine:
[spoiler]
You need 1 piece of paper + the cooked food you want to be packaged.
Hold the food and click on the machine.
It takes 60 in game minutes for the food to be packaged.
[/spoiler]
How to get paper:
[spoiler]
There is two ways!
Buy from Pierre.
Recycle 10 pieces of wood or 1 piece of hardwood.
[/spoiler]
Packaged food sells for double the original price + 30 and is a universally liked gift.

[size=3]Warning, you can't unpackage food that is already packaged[/size][size=4] [/size]⚠️
